caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a doll-like figure positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The figure has a round head with painted facial features including black eyebrows, black eyes with white pupils, a nose, and an open mouth. The doll is wearing a white bonnet or head covering. The body of the doll consists of a dress with a wide, bell-shaped skirt and long sleeves, all decorated with symmetrical patterns. The patterns feature red, blue, and pink flower-like shapes with green and gold details set against a white or off-white background, giving the appearance of lace or embroidery. The doll has small protruding hands, colored in a light beige or yellowish shade. The overall composition is simple, with the figure standing upright and centered within a rectangular frame that is itself bordered by a thin, straight line close to the edges of the paper.
title: Doll
